name: clarify
description: Ask 3–10 scored questions with a confidence meter before building a feature or fixing a bug.

interface.longDescription: Clarify helps software teams turn a feature idea or bug report into a brief before editing code. It reviews the designs, specs, evidence, and code you provide or make available, then asks 3–10 questions one at a time. A weighted completeness meter shows which details are clear and which need more input; it is not a probability that a plan or fix is correct. Feature briefs cover scope, UI, data, and acceptance criteria. Bug briefs cover reproduction steps, a proposed fix, and verification. Clarify asks for approval before implementation. Available context and tools depend on the host application; the plugin does not include an MCP server or a connection to Sortly inventory data.
capabilities: Draft feature briefs with scope and acceptance criteria
Draft bug briefs with reproduction steps and verification
Track requirement completeness with weighted scores
defaultPrompt: Use Clarify to plan a new settings page from this design.
Use Clarify to pin down why the checkout button does nothing on Safari.
